generation_checks: all 256 values present exactly once at all 16 positions per method

methodology.candidate_construction: Vary one K0 byte through 00..ff; hold the other 15 recovered K0 bytes fixed.
methodology.key_schedule: Expand each complete candidate K0 into its candidate K10.
methodology.saved_profile_score: Sum_j(profile_j(candidate_coordinate_j) - profile_j(recovered_coordinate_j)). Coordinates are K10[j] for expanded and K10[j] XOR K10[0] for simple.
methodology.joint_score: When --exact-dataset is used, evaluate the original sum of 120 pair scores on each expanded candidate instead of adding saved profile supports.
methodology.ordering: Descending score; exact ties are ordered by ascending hexadecimal byte value.
methodology.limitations: Conditional on the other 15 recovered bytes. Saved-profile mode uses an additive surrogate over correlated max-profile supports, not the original joint score or a probability. These are not independent pre-recovery byte rankings.
